releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.22:
- Display & Kiosk Setup Hub: Integrated management console in Settings > Hardware & Printers for effortlessly pairing Kitchen KDS, Bar KDS, Special Orders, Lobby TV, Photo Hub, Hostess, and Secondary POS registers.
- USB Flash Drive Individual Installer Exporter: Plug any USB drive into the main register to automatically export a zero-configuration, standalone station installer with matching icons and live network parameters.
- Tablet QR Code Instant Pairing: Crisp QR code scanning for tablet and mobile screens connecting kitchen and station displays without manually typing IP addresses.
- KDS Kiosk Installer Fix: Eliminated shell redirection syntax issue in Windows batch script ensuring seamless background launcher creation and auto-start on boot.
- Dynamic LAN Auto-Detection: Built-in local IP discovery dynamically injects host register address into station packages.
- Zero Regressions: Verified 100% modal integrity across all 72 modal dialogs with 0 errors.
